cross_verification.note_en: SMF's official e-Visa portal (smf.st/evisa) lists required documents for entry visas to Sao Tome and Principe: a digitized passport (PDF) valid at least 3 months beyond the visa's stated departure date, and proof of subsistence funds (EUR 100/day). No standalone identity photograph (dimensions, background, pose) is specified as a required upload on the reachable e-Visa portal pages. No further official Sao Tome and Principe government photo specification for visas could be located.
